title: L5 burst rate precision: proposal implemented, queue row removed

leads.title: Burst cadence
leads.statusNote: Burst-rate precision proposal closed 30 Oct 2026: weapons.json already stores the exact source rates (site commit 88bc25d, 28 Sep, L107 full-precision pass); the operator agreed on 30 October.
leads.summary: Bursts per minute, rounds per burst and the fire-mode enum are sourced; the six burst weapons store no BPM. GRT-BC and SL9 bursts per minute were corrected on 28 September, and their within-burst rates are stored at source precision (GRT-BC burstRpm 830.769 and fireModes.burst.rpm 830.7689819335938; SL9 771.428 and 771.427978515625), so the 'burst rate precision' proposal is implemented and its queue row is removed.
leads.reopenWhen: A game update changes RateOfFireForBurst or BurstsPerMinute on a burst weapon, or an in-game recording shows a pause between bursts the stored values do not explain.

note: Status re-recorded on 30 Oct 2026 at the operator's instruction (item 8h of the review-gaps session). No new source evidence; the 28 Sep receipt holds the raw checks (MSBSGROTB_WB RateOfFireForBurst 830.7689819335938). The queue row 'Operator review: burst rate precision' is deleted and the awaiting-operator line no longer lists it. The L15 shootingDecScale row stays for the operator's choice.
